pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular, dark-brown polygonal regions. Edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients with rounded vertices rather than sharp geometric angles. Patch area decreases significantly towards the posterior and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological grid. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent (Y-shaped). Pathway thickness is consistent and narrow across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane presents a dark, short-haired silhouette with a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged edge against the lighter background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct structural break in the continuous mane line is caused by the presence of an oxpecker perched on the dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a bird (likely an oxpecker) perched on the mid-dorsal ridge.
